title: Deferral of Recent Self-Help Charges at Reinstatement — Community Rules & Site Care Resident Terms
content:
When a reinstatement payment is worked out under Community Rules & Site Care, the self-help charges on the statement dated within the 3 calendar months ending on the handling date may be deferred to the next statement. The deferral turns on tenure, counted in whole calendar months from the move-in date on the Home-Site Lease to the handling date, and on returned payments on the Home-Site Lease ledger within the 12 calendar months ending on the handling date:

1. with at least 120 months of tenure and no returned payment, those charges are deferred in full;
2. when the first condition does not hold but the resident has at least 60 months of tenure and at most one returned payment, half of them is deferred, that half rounded down to the whole dollar;
3. otherwise none is deferred.

The deferred amount is subtracted from the reinstatement balance, and what remains once every amount allowed to stay on the statement has been subtracted is never less than zero.

## Combinations

| Tenure (whole calendar months) | Returned payments in the 12 months | Deferred |
|---|---|---|
| 120 or more | none | all of the charges |
| 120 or more | one | half, rounded down |
| 60 to 119 | none or one | half, rounded down |
| 60 or more | two or more | none |
| fewer than 60 | any | none |

## Worked case

Hypothetical self-help charges of $105.00 and $90.00 dated within the 3 months, $195.00 in all: rule 1 defers $195.00; rule 2 defers half, $97.50, rounded down to $97.00; rule 3 defers nothing.
